A. Schizophrenia
    B. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
    C. Major Depressive Disorder

And yeah, I've been feeling down, pretty low most days. It’s hard to get motivated, and I just feel tired. But even when I'm feeling alright, not particularly down at all, my brain still feels like it’s in neutral. This isn’t a new thing that just popped up with the sadness; I’ve always struggled with staying focused and remembering things, long before this recent slump started.
